x-bump-note: 1.0.0 initial. Permissive schema for APM and EM rulings stored as state/{rulings,apm-rulings}/*.md. Nothing is required and the key set is open, because the corpus holds frontmatter-less records and many ad-hoc keys; only the canonical fields are typed.
description: A ruling record: frontmatter, then a prose body. Every key is optional and unknown keys are admitted; a frontmatter-less record projects to {} and validates. Canonical fields are typed only where every corpus value already satisfies the type. Synonym map for readers: `ruled_by` is canonical and `ruling_by`, `ruler`, `author` and `reviewer` are legacy synonyms a reader maps to it; `verdict` is canonical and `ruling` is its legacy synonym.

verdict.description: The ruling's outcome. Canonical; legacy synonym: `ruling`.

ruling.description: Legacy synonym of `verdict`; readers map it.

source_ask.description: The ask that prompted the ruling.

ruled_by.description: Who ruled. Canonical; legacy synonyms `ruling_by`, `ruler`, `author` and `reviewer` are mapped by readers.

needs_pm.description: True when the ruling needs the PM's eyes.

pm_must_see.description: True when the PM must see the ruling.
